title: alsine minuta
intro: Alsine minuta, commonly known as minute sweet clover, is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, including its ability to support digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Alsine minuta are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Alsine minuta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
